items.title: George Guesnon Interview, 1965-09
items.q: Now, Rolf, we're going to wake on endings now. I'm going to give you two or three different endings in one key, which will be the key of G for you. I want you to learn from them to take and transpose it from that one particular key to all of your keys.

ctx.x: This is a tape recorded September 8, 1965 at the home of Creole George Gano, band jurist and guitarist of New Orleans, Louisiana at 1012 North Roman Street, where I've got my friend here, little friend here from Sweden, Rolf Wald, nice little trumpet man. I mean, I've been missing that you play some stuff and you play real nice. I try to anyway, but I mean, you know, the stuff that you're kind of picking up on is not jazz and it's true beauty, and this is the stuff that brought you down here and try to let you…
Well, all right. There you go.
